dishes.name: Papalines d'Avignon
dishes.desc: Emblematic Avignon confection created in 1960 by the Vaucluse pastry masters' guild. Around sixty confectioners in the département still make it by hand.

dishes.name: Daube avignonnaise
dishes.desc: Beef stew slowly simmered in wine, better the day after it is made, and in the Avignon version cooked gently with anchovies. A staple of Provençal home cooking.

dishes.name: Crespeou
dishes.desc: A terrine of layered coloured omelettes, from the Comtat Venaissin. Farmers once carried it to the fields, and it is eaten cold.

dishes.name: Berlingots de Carpentras
dishes.desc: Berlingots de Carpentras are boiled sweets from Carpentras in the Vaucluse, a town better known for its truffle market and other Ventoux produce.

dishes.name: Fruits confits d'Apt
dishes.desc: Candied fruit, the specialty of Apt in the Luberon. Especially common at Christmas and over the winter festive season.
